text: @AmazonHelp where is my order 112-3847291? It was supposed to be delivered yesterday.
@115712 We would be happy to check your tracking details. Please DM us your order number and full name: amzn.to/help
@AmazonHelp I sent the return for order 113-9928172 last week. When will my refund show up?
@115713 Refunds typically take 3-5 business days once processed by our fulfillment center. Reach out via DM if you need further help.
@AmazonHelp Tracking says package delivered handed to resident but I was at work and nothing is on my porch!
@115714 We are sorry to hear this! Please check with neighbors or building management and DM us your order details if still missing.
@AmazonHelp I am completely locked out of my account and cannot reset my password because the phone number is old.
@115715 For account security we cannot verify details on Twitter. Please contact our account recovery specialists at amazon.com/help.
@AmazonHelp Why did Amazon charge my card $14.99 twice for Prime subscription? Please refund this unauthorized charge.
@115716 We understand your concern regarding charges. Please log in securely to review your billing history at amzn.to/manage.
@AmazonHelp My air fryer arrived with a shattered glass basket. The box was heavily dented.
@115717 We apologize for the damaged item! You can request a replacement or return directly via Your Orders: amzn.to/returns.
@AmazonHelp Do you provide gift wrapping options for orders shipped from third party marketplace sellers?
@115718 Gift wrap availability depends on the individual seller. Look for the Gift options checkbox at checkout.
@AmazonHelp tracking number 938472910 has not updated in 4 days with USPS. Can you look into this?
@115719 We would like to check on this shipment. Please DM us your 17-digit order number so we can investigate.
@AmazonHelp returned a defective laptop 10 days ago. Tracking shows delivered to warehouse but no refund yet.
@115720 Please allow 3-5 business days after warehouse receipt for the refund to reflect. Send us a DM to verify.
@AmazonHelp driver left my package out in the heavy rain and the electronics are soaked and ruined.
@115721 We are so sorry to hear this. Please contact us via DM with your order ID so we can make this right.
@AmazonHelp not receiving 2FA verification codes to log into Amazon Prime Video on my TV.
@115722 We are here to assist. Please ensure your registered mobile number is up to date or visit amazon.com/help.
@AmazonHelp credit card statement shows unexpected $79 charge from Amazon Digital Services.
@115723 You can review all digital subscriptions and charges at amazon.com/yourmembershipsandsubscriptions.
@AmazonHelp received a completely different book than what I ordered. I ordered Python Crash Course and got a novel.
@115724 That certainly should not happen! Please head to Your Orders to start a free wrong-item replacement.
@AmazonHelp what time does Amazon Locker pickup close near downtown Seattle?
@115725 Locker access hours depend on the host location operating hours. You can view the hours in your delivery email.
